text:
Alice W: Heads-up: prepping webinar landing + 3 launch posts. Need an SEO quick pass today — keywords, JSON-LD snippet, internal links, and redirects for legacy CTAs. Can we triage?
Miguel R: On it — can we prioritize keyword buckets per post? I can map 3 per post.
Chloe (Content): Yep. I'll share draft headlines in ~2h. Are we doing canonical consolidation for old webinar pages?
Leo (Devex): We should canonicalize old pages to the new landing. Also ensure AMP pages (if any) have meta canonical. I can add redirect rules after content lock.
seo-bot: Reminder: sitemap ping scheduled at 18:00 UTC. New pages need <priority>0.8 and lastmod set.
Alice W: Miguel, assign keywords to each draft and add target SERP intent (informational/commercial). Chloe, include a 160-char meta desc per draft.
Miguel R: I'll annotate the Google Sheet: https://docs.google.com/.../edit — done in 2h.
Chloe (Content): Drafts: landing + post A (benchmark narrative), post B (how we scaled inference), post C (webinar recap). I'll include schema samples. @Leo can you review JSON-LD placement?
Leo (Devex): Yes. Standard place is head > script type=application/ld+json. For server-rendered pages we inject at build. For client-only pages, pre-render the snippet. Example:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Redwood Inference — Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms","breadcrumb":{"@type":"BreadcrumbList","itemListElement":[{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Home","item":"https://redwood.ai/"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"name":"Resources","item":"https://redwood.ai/resources"}]}}
```
Alice W: :thumbsup: Nice. Also we need internal linking plan: landing -> product pages, benchmark -> graph of results, recap -> signup. Miguel add 3 anchor texts per link.
Miguel R: Will do. Also flagging redirect chain risk from /webinars/* old slug. @Leo can you add rewrite rule to 301 to new landing but preserve utm? Example: `rewrite ^/webinars/(.*)$ /webinar/$1 permanent;`
Leo (Devex): I'll implement a redirect that preserves querystring: `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/new-slug?$query_string;` Need final slugs by EOD.
Chloe (Content): Final slug suggestions in sheet. Also adding open graph tags + image: `og:image` sized 1200x630.
seo-bot: Audit flags: missing H1 on post B draft; duplicate meta descriptions between post A and landing. Will re-run once drafts are updated.
Alice W: Owners/tasks:
- Chloe: drafts + meta + slugs (EOD)
- Miguel: keywords + anchor plan (EOD)
- Leo: redirect rules + JSON-LD placement (tomorrow morning)
- SEO-bot: final scan after deploy
We should lock content by 16:00 PT. If any blocker ping me.
Miguel R: Noted. Will tag with priority labels in sheet.
Chloe (Content): Quick Q: Do we want canonical tags set to landing for older recap posts or preserve separate canonical per post? Thinking separate is better for long-term search.
Alice W: Prefer separate canonical per evergreen post. Only redirect /webinars/old-splash pages that are duplicates to landing.
Leo (Devex): Agree. I'll mark which old slugs are duplicates in the ticket and mass-redirect those.
Alice W: :rocket: Thanks team. I'll post final checklist in the marketing ops board.
